text: 下面进入小作文 02 · 投诉与维权信：网购商品质量破损与售后服务冷漠答题骨架与变体精解。
第一段：直入主题，表明正式投诉意向与事由。
I am writing this letter to lodge a formal complaint concerning the substandard quality of the books I purchased and the unprofessional attitude of your staff.
加分短语：lodge a formal complaint 替换简单的 complain about。
第二段：客观列举事实细节，指出商品缺陷与服务失职。
When the parcel arrived yesterday, I was shocked to find that the covers were torn and several key pages were missing.
表达不满情感句型：Even more frustrating was that...
Even more frustrating was that my inquiry was met with total indifference.
第三段：严肃督促整改，明确要求换货或全额退款。
Therefore, I deem it imperative that an immediate replacement or a full refund be arranged promptly.
高分虚拟语气句：I deem it imperative that sb. (should) do...
I deem it imperative that effective rectifying measures be taken promptly.
